**Preview build: not yet tested on a real phone.** It builds and passes its automated tests, but expect rough edges. Please [report problems](https://github.com/kelleyparker/multistream-android/issues).

### What it does
Streams your phone's camera and mic to **YouTube, Twitch and Kick at the same time**, plus any custom RTMP/RTMPS server. The encoding happens on the phone and there's no relay server. YouTube can get up to 1440p60 while Twitch and Kick get 1080p60.

### Install
1. On your phone, tap **`APK_NAME`** below to download it.
2. Open it, and allow installs from your browser when Android asks.
3. Tap **Install**. Future releases install over this one and keep your saved platforms.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer.

### Try it safely first
Follow [docs/TESTING.md](https://github.com/kelleyparker/multistream-android/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md) to stream to a free test server on your computer before going live for real.

### Checksum
SHA-256 of `APK_NAME`: `APK_SHA256`
